Class AbstractAction

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.actions.AbstractAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Action<Void>, VoidAction
Direct Known Subclasses:

public abstract class AbstractAction extends Object implements VoidAction
AbstractAction is an abstract class that implements the Action interface with default behaviors.
